about: Inputs and expected outcome of the export stage's fixture (make stage-export; rapidpipe selftest --stage export). The real export port (supervisor step 8, 2026-09-24, ruling R12): a fake database (rapidpipe.selftest.support.fakeexport) holds two named source sets (120 + 80 sources scattered 0.01 deg around one position, every tenth flagged), one source set that is not named (its rows must not be read) and one named association set (recorded, unused); hats-import runs for real with and without --real-tools. flags_zero_only is off (dev's default), so all 200 named rows are exported.
